title: XQS Berrynana Twist Nicotine Pouches - 8mg/Pouch
description: XQS Berrynana Twist tastes smooth and fruity, bringing mellow Banana together with bright mixed Berry notes for a balanced profile. Each slim, all‑white pouch fits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. This can contains 20 pouches in 8mg (Strong). Developed in Sweden by XQS, the range focuses on flavour clarity and simple, familiar combinations in a discreet format. Nicotine Ranges: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
